title: TABLECONTENT three linked cells in one grid

scope.operation: Qualify multiple TABLECONTENT linked-cell references to distinct emitted DATALINK records in one rectangular grid.
scope.profile: Generated 2x2 AC1032 TABLECONTENT with three linked cells, one scalar-only cell, two cached values in one linked cell, one cached string in another, and three distinct rooted DATALINK records; ASCII and binary output.
scope.source_basis: The existing writer and adapter preflight traverse the table grid generically and impose an aggregate 10,000-cell bound rather than a two-link limit. The prior focused regression covered only two linked cells, leaving the intended multi-link behavior unproven.
implementation: Extend the generated linked-grid regression from two to three distinct linked cells without adding a production special case.
Verify each TABLECONTENT group-340 target remaps to the matching emitted DATALINK, while linked flags, row/column metadata and cached values stay attached to their cells.
Independently remove each of the three targets; require refusal, destination preservation, unchanged caller model and same-adapter corrected retry with readback.
scope.claim_boundary: Selected generated three-link AC1032 grid transport in ASCII and binary DXF. Code inspection confirms the existing adapter/writer path is generic over grid cells, but this profile does not test the 10,000-cell boundary, other cached-value sequences, FIELD/block/attribute/geometry payloads, DWG output or native table behavior.

evidence.physical_wire: Wire inspection verifies three linked flags, three remapped DATALINK targets, exact per-cell row/column/unknown fields, cached content counts, and a remaining scalar-only cell.
evidence.typed_readback: Fresh imports preserve all three link targets, row/column metadata, both cached values in the first linked cell, the cached string in the second linked cell, and scalar content in the unlinked cell.
evidence.failure_controls: Each of the three referenced DATALINK handles is independently changed to a missing target; export refuses, preserves a destination sentinel and leaves the caller's invalid handle unchanged.
evidence.retry_control: Restoring each target permits same-adapter output; fresh readback confirms all three links after every retry.

remaining: Additional linked-cell FIELD, block, attribute and geometry payloads remain open.
This selected grid profile does not qualify maximum cell-count or native rendering behavior.
